Skills.Name: Morning unread summary
Skills.Description: Summarize unread Inbox mail received since yesterday at 5:00 PM.
Skills.Prompt: Summarize unread messages in my primary Inbox received inclusively from {{yesterday_5pm_local_iso}} through {{now_local_iso}}. Use search_mailbox with query an empty string, folder inbox, unread_only true, received_after and received_before set to those exact timestamps, and max_results set to the maximum allowed by the tool. Follow next_cursor until enumeration_complete is true, including empty pages. Read every returned message and follow next_body_offset until body_complete. Start with the heading Morning unread summary, then state the exact window and number summarized. Put important or action-required messages first. Then list every remaining message as Sender — Subject — one-sentence summary. Do not stop at a page limit. Report any unreadable messages or truncated attachments as incomplete coverage, retaining source references. If there are no matches, say exactly: No unread messages arrived in this window. Do not create a draft or change any message.

Skills.Name: Translate from Korean
Skills.Description: Translate Korean text in the selected column, or automatically replace Korean text throughout the workbook when no selection was sent.
Skills.Prompt: Translate Korean text to English. If the local host supplied detected Korean workbook cells, use write_korean_translations to translate every supplied source entry in order and replace exactly those detected literal cells throughout the workbook; continue sequentially until complete, do not ask for confirmation or a destination, and never save. Formula and merged cells must remain unchanged. Otherwise, translate every cell in the attached Excel selection, treating the attached selection as the complete scope: include the first cell or header, preserve blank row positions, and produce exactly one output value per selected row. For an attached selection use write_selection_output and preserve the source, writing to the immediately adjacent blank column by default. Do not ask whether to translate the header or whether to create a new draft or replace the source. If the adjacent destination is unavailable, explain why and ask the user to choose from the empty candidate columns returned by the tool. Never save the workbook.
